artworks.title: Le Duc de Guise, Roy Ameriquain
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a regal figure seated on a horse. The figure is in profile view facing left with focused facial features, long wavy hair flowing from under an elaborate helmet, and intricate armor. The horse is adorned with decorative trappings matching the rider's aesthetic. The rider holds a lance, and above them is a blank banner with ribbons and foliage. The background is simple, emphasizing the figure and horse.

artworks.title: Cheval de Main et Palfreniers Romains
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horse and a figure in a theatrical or ceremonial setting. The horse is adorned with elaborate decorations and the figure appears to be orchestrating the horse's performance. A ribbon-like structure above them adds a whimsical touch to the composition. The style of the drawing is reminiscent of Baroque art, with detailed and dramatic expression.

artworks.title: The Mermaid and the Monkey
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection

artworks.title: Hunters at the Edge of the Woods
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray and black wash over black chalk
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape scene with a horizon line about halfway up the composition. Distant trees and clouds are visible in the sky. Two figures are walking along a path with a small dog near some trees. The brushstrokes are delicate and precise, resembling a pencil or ink drawing. The color palette is subdued, with soft grays and sepia tones. In the background, the landscape transitions into a densely wooded area, while the foreground has sparse vegetation.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child Accompanied by Saints
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a group of four figures in a tight arrangement, displaying their upper bodies. The central figure is a seated woman holding a young child on her lap. The child reaches towards another smaller child, who is reaching out to the central figure. To the left, a figure wearing a headscarf is holding a flower. On the right, an older male figure with a short beard is looking towards the woman and child and holding a slender instrument. The figures are dressed in draped garments and the background shows a simple interior space with a small window or opening in the top right corner, letting in light, and an inscription in the top left corner.

artworks.title: Lithographer
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: This is a detailed painting of a lithographer's workshop. The scene showcases different stages of the lithographic printing process. On the left, an individual is preparing a stone slab for printing with tools nearby. In the center, an artist is drawing on a stone slab, surrounded by images and samples on the wall. On the right, another figure is operating a printing press. The colors, lighting, and detailing create a vivid representation of the workshop. The space is well-lit with natural light coming through large windows. The painting is in the style of L. Prang & Co.

artworks.title: Thirty Archers and Pages
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of mounted figures in elaborate attire. The drawing depicts a procession of mounted riders, each on horseback, dressed in ornate clothing with plumes and embellishments. The composition of the image shows the riders closely clustered, with various poses suggesting motion and energy among the group. The horses, depicted from behind and in profile, are adorned with decorative accoutrements. The overall arrangement and fine detailing of the etching emphasize the pomp and ceremony of the cavalcade.

artworks.title: Twenty Pages and Five Turkish Horses
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: This drawing shows a group of mounted figures in formation. The procession includes figures on horseback, each wearing feathered headdresses. The horses display different gaits, creating a sense of movement. The figures are dressed in detailed clothing, possibly ceremonial or formal attire. The background is simple to emphasize the figures and horses. Thin, uniform lines are used throughout the composition. The drawing is labeled with an inscription at the bottom.

artworks.title: Master of His Excellency's Stables and Twenty Servants
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a procession featuring horses and elaborately dressed figures. The scene shows a long line of horses with figures either mounted on them or walking alongside. The figures are in ornamental attire. The drawing is detailed, capturing the movement and positioning of the animals and figures, and includes textual elements at the bottom. The style of the drawing is consistent with works depicting historical or ceremonial events with a focus on detailed line work and composition.

artworks.title: Spanish Gentlemen, Polish and French Horsemen
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of mounted figures and others on foot gathered under a large tree. The scene depicts a multitude of figures, both on horseback and walking, gathered beneath the arching branches of a prominent tree. The tree's trunk divides the assembly into two groups. The figures appear to be finely dressed. The figures’ postures and the horses’ positions suggest a moment of interaction. There is a historic setting, with the attire indicating a period from the past. The use of line and shadow adds depth to the drawing, emphasizing the texture of the tree and the details of the clothing worn by the figures.

artworks.title: Polish Nobles, His Excellency the Ambassador, and His Carriage
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a procession featuring figures on horseback. The scene captures a large group of people, primarily mounted on horses, depicted in detailed outline against a landscape setting. The figures, both on horseback and on foot, appear to be part of a ceremonial or formal gathering. The background includes some trees and distant structures suggestive of a village or settlement. Annotations in the lower part of the artwork add contextual elements. The drawing is rich in detail, emphasizing the movement and grouping of figures, which creates a dynamic and lively scene.

artworks.title: The Artist's Son Claude or "Coco"
artworks.medium: collotype touched with red and white chalk
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Paul B. Magnuson
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a person in profile, seated and turned slightly to the left. The person has short, straight hair and soft, child-like facial features. They are wearing a garment and appear to be engaged in an activity, reaching towards a surface in front of them. The background is a smooth, monotone wash, and the overall image is rendered in warm sepia tones.

artworks.title: Luther as an Augustinian Friar
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 14.1 x 9.7 cm (5 9/16 x 3 13/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: This image shows a sketch of a person from the chest upwards, positioned in a three-quarter view facing slightly to the left. The person has a well-defined jawline and large eyes, with high cheekbones and a straight nose. Their hair is short and combed back, with a slight receding hairline. The person is depicted wearing a robe with a high, wide collar that covers part of their neck. The robe appears to be plain, with no visible patterns or accessories. There are no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background is simple and unadorned, providing a neutral setting for the figure. Below the portrait, there is an inscription in Latin, which accompanies the drawing and includes the date "M.D.XX" (1520).

artworks.title: Auguste Rodin
artworks.artist: John Henry Ellsworth Whitney, after Alphonse Legros
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. George Matthew Adams
artworks.description: The image is a head-and-shoulders side profile portrait of a man in a sketch or drawing style. The man is facing the left, with his head slightly tilted up. He has a strong nose, high cheekbones, full beard and mustache, and dark, textured hair. The individual has no visible clothing or accessories. The background has a textured pattern.

artworks.title: Fra Filippo Lippi, Enslaved in Algiers, Painting a Portrait of His Captor
artworks.medium: etching, stipple, engraving, and printed tone on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of John Ellerton Lodge
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man sculpting a bust while two others observe. The central focus shows a muscular figure sculpting a bust, with their back turned. The figure wears textured clothing. To the right, a figure in a turban and lavish clothing watches, accompanied by another figure holding a tool, possibly a feather duster. The setting includes tree branches on the left and a vase with flowers on a pedestal on the right, hinting at an artistic and natural space. The drawing displays detailed linework and a contrast of light and shadow.

artworks.title: Cardinal de Polignac
artworks.artist: François Chereau I after Hyacinthe Rigaud
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of John Ellerton Lodge
artworks.description: The image shows an older man seated, with his full upper body visible, and part of his legs. He is positioned facing slightly to the side, with his head turned to the right, giving a three-quarter profile view of his face. His facial features include a prominent nose, full lips, and eyes that are gazing off into the distance. He has curly hair that falls to his shoulders. He is wearing ornate clerical robes with elaborate lace detailing and a large star-shaped insignia on his chest. In his hands, he holds a large, open book with visible text on the pages. Around him is an intricately designed chair with decorative armrests. The background consists of tall, textured columns and drapery, adding depth to the setting.

artworks.title: Saint Bartholomew
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of John Ellerton Lodge
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing upright, facing forward with his head slightly turned to his left. He has distinct facial features, including a curly beard and curly hair, giving him an aged appearance. He is wearing a long robe with intricate design details. In his right hand, he holds a large, curved sword, and in his left arm, he cradles a closed book. Behind him is a large tree trunk, near which there is a small rectangular panel with the year "1523" inscribed on it along with an artistic monogram. The ground is textured, and the background has a light texture.

artworks.title: Love Scene from Act III of "Lohengrin"
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of John Ellerton Lodge
artworks.description: The image shows two people seated closely together. One person is partially in the lap of the other. The person on the right has a visible face with short, wavy hair; the other person's face is less discernible as they appear to be looking away. Both individuals wear draped clothing with loose, flowing textures. The background includes a night scene with a bright area on the left, surrounded by trees or foliage, and perhaps a structure or archway to the right.

artworks.title: Sieglinde and Siegmund from Act I of "The Valkyrie"
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of John Ellerton Lodge
artworks.description: The image shows two people in an intimate setting. The first person is depicted from the waist up and is bent over facing the second person, who is shown seated, possibly on the ground, with their upper body leaning back slightly. The person leaning over has wavy hair pulled back and appears to be offering something small, possibly a cup, which they hold up to the seated person's face. The seated person has short, curly hair and is looking up towards the first person. Both individuals' facial features are not detailed, focusing more on the interaction between them. They both wear flowing garments with draped, textured fabric. The environment around them is not distinct, featuring a swirling, textured, dark background that suggests a dimly lit or nighttime setting, with few discernible details other than the emphasis on the interaction between the two figures.

artworks.title: Maria Cecilia Louisa Cosway
artworks.artist: after Valentine Green after Maria Cosway
artworks.medium: color photogravure inked  à la poupée on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of John Ellerton Lodge
artworks.description: The image displays a woman from the waist up, seated with her arms crossed. She gazes directly at the viewer with a soft expression. She has fair skin, arched eyebrows, and slightly parted lips. Her hair is styled in tight curls with a light blue turban. She wears a white ruffled garment with a high collar and long sleeves. A pastel lavender sash is wrapped around her, and she has a black ribbon or piece of jewelry around her neck. Gold drop earrings are visible. The background is muted brown and seems to suggest a horizon over water. She sits on a richly colored chair.

artworks.title: Old Chelsea (Old Chelsea Church)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of John Ellerton Lodge
artworks.description: The image shows a river with a cityscape in the background. In the skyline, there are buildings and tall trees. The river features boats and figures. A tower is visible on the left side of the image, along with groups of rooftops stretching towards the right. The etching uses fine lines to create texture and movement in the sky and water. The scene is monochromatic, with varying shades of black and brown against a light background.

artworks.title: Breaking Up of the Agamemnon
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of John Ellerton Lodge
artworks.description: The image shows a harbor with a large ship in the center. The horizon is in the upper third of the image with other vessels around the ship. The etching technique is used to depict fine details of the ship, water, and structures. The color scheme is mainly sepia. Smaller boats are near us on the water, with waves lightly etched. In the distance, more ships and a domed building can be seen against a sky with swirling cloud patterns.

artworks.title: Kensington Gardens (The Small Plate)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of John Ellerton Lodge
artworks.description: The image shows a wooded area with tall trees framing a distant grand building with classical architecture. Fine etching lines depict the texture and depth of the trees and building. The color palette is mainly sepia and tan, creating a nostalgic atmosphere. Light and shadow add dimension to the scene.

artworks.title: The Large Shepherdess (La grande bergere)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of John Ellerton Lodge
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with a high-angle view of the landscape. A lone figure stands in the foreground with a staff, while a herd of sheep grazes in the distance. The horizon is defined by trees and shrubs, creating depth. The style features intricate line work typical of etching, with detailed strokes for texture. The color palette is sepia, giving a vintage look to the image.
